integrity: All primitive Frobenius-adjoint laws independently checked by direct finite enumeration through ten elements. General proof is self-contained. No external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite standard Łukasiewicz chains only. Classification does not extend to arbitrary MV-algebras, products, or monadic expansions. The fixed-point and divisor-subalgebra principles are prior mathematics; historical-priority risk under alternate terminology remains.
title: Divisor classification of Frobenius-adjoint expansions of finite Łukasiewicz chains
